name: Zhejiang Garden Biopharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Garden Biopharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production and sales of vitamin products and pharmaceuticals in China. The company offers lanolin cholesterol series products, such as cholesterol and feed grade cholesterol; vitamin D3 products, including food additives compound nutrient fortifier SDS, food additives compound nutritional fortifier CO and MO, cholecalciferol, vitamin D3 particles, feed additive vitamin D3 oil, and VD3 resin oil; and 25 HydroxyVitamin D3 Progen, 25 hydroxyvitamin D3, and 25 hydroxyvitamin D3 powder.
